accessible_toilet.note: One, on the ground floor, beside the stage

sources.quote: There is one wheelchair accessible toilet located on the ground floor, accessed from the right hand side of the stage in the Chapel.

alt_accessible_entrance.note: Ground level, at the back; advised for powered wheelchairs, with a staff escort

sources.quote: We also have an alternative entrance which is ground level.
It is safest for electric wheelchair users to gain access via the rear of the Chapel.

entrance_step_free.note: Three steps; staff put out a ramp

sources.quote: Access to the Chapel is via the main entrance has three stone steps to the doors of the Chapel. We can ensure there is a ramp ready for entry with door staff on hand for any assistance if this is suitable for your requirements.

lift.note: A stair/platform lift to the bar only, 300kg

sources.quote: Step free access to the bar is available with a stair/platform lift.

notes: The page says wheelchair spaces are booked online with a Nimbus Access Card, and that there's an induction loop (ask ahead), without giving a number of spaces or saying which room the loop serves. The listings name no screen.

step_free_access.note: By a ramp at the main entrance, or a ground-level entrance at the back

sources.quote: Access to the Chapel is via the main entrance has three stone steps to the doors of the Chapel. We can ensure there is a ramp ready for entry with door staff on hand for any assistance if this is suitable for your requirements.
We also have an alternative entrance which is ground level.
